items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): arrows = move 1 tile; short presses (~0.12s) give single steps, longer presses repeat; Space = WAIT on levels, but on overworld it cycles map zoom and then enters the level under Baba; Z = undo (works after deaths), R = restart (shows YES/NO prompt; Down+Return confirms); Escape opens pause menu (RESUME, RETURN TO MAP, RESTART, SETTINGS, RETURN TO MENU) — keyboard Down+Return works; mouse clicks on menu buttons unreliable; pointer hover can add highlights/tooltips. The UNDO/RESTART bar is always visible and does NOT indicate death; death = player sprite disappears. Level entry from map = stand on level icon + Space (may need two Spaces: zoom then enter).

PROGRESS: Solved Level 1 'WHERE DO I GO?' (formed FLAG IS WIN beside flag sprite after breaking WALL IS STOP), Level 3 'OUT OF REACH' (flag sealed in water; formed vertical ROCK IS WIN in lower-right room by pushing WIN up under PUSH, then touched the rock in the checkered room), Level 2 'NOW WHAT IS THIS?' (broke FLAG IS STOP so flags passable; all WALL bricks move together under WALL IS YOU; formed vertical FLAG IS WIN (FLAG/IS/WIN) in pen column and stepped a brick onto a flag). Star counter reached 4 after Level 2. Entered Level 4 from map cave slot '04'.

LEVEL 4 'STILL OUT OF REACH' (current, unsolved). Observed layout: global-style rule tiles top-left: FLAG IS WIN (y~120) and pink BA/IS/YOU (y~175) on a checkered niche/panel; on open black floor ROCK IS PUSH at ~(270-385,305); a fully sealed ring of red skulls (left wall x~690, top y~228, right x~985, bottom y~515) enclosing the glowing yellow flag at (875,450) and words SKULL IS DEFEAT at x~745-785,y~295-380 (interior). Golden pushable rocks: free at (440,268), and several plugging left-wall cells (690,268)/(690,300)/(700,228). Observed rules active: BABA IS YOU (white blob), FLAG IS WIN, ROCK IS PUSH, SKULL IS DEFEAT (skulls kill Baba on contact; rocks pushed into skulls annihilate both, leaving an empty wall cell). Interior column x~725-960 appears open; walls must be avoided.

FAILED STRATEGIES: repeatedly died entering the ring's left wall at rows ~268/~300/~303 even where a rock had cleared a cell (deaths possibly from residual/hidden skull or row misalignment); died overshooting rightward to the right-wall skulls (x~985) with long presses; pushing top rock (440,228) right along top wall created openings only to later step into a remaining corner skull (690,228); moving Left into a skull at (405,370) killed Baba; long Right press at flag row overshot the flag and hit right wall.

ACTIVE GOAL/HYPOTHESES: primary hypothesis — build 'ROCK IS WIN' outside the ring (possibly by relocating the WIN word from the top-left panel down to the ROCK IS row at ~305, if those panel tiles are movable) then touch a rock; untested whether panel words are movable or fixed (guess: they may be fixed global rules or movable tiles). Alternative: find a genuinely safe entry row in the left wall (~345-450 has been traversed before), walk inside with single steps at x~725-735, descend to row ~450, and touch the flag at (875,450) while FLAG IS WIN is active, stopping before x~985. Last action: Baba near (443,125) was moving right along row ~125 toward x~660, intending to descend to ~row 345 for a careful ring entry; before that attempted Left to reach panel WIN tile. Current state uncertain (Baba's exact position/mortality after the last long Right press unknown); Z available to rewind, R to restart.
